'''Seri''' is a ''[[damane]]'' from [[Seanchan]].

== Appearance ==
She is pale-faced.

== Activities ==
She is with a group of soldiers in Seanchan, when they find the [[Gateway]] left by [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Aviendha]]. She is held by bonds of Air by [[Aviendha]], who then tries to take Seri's ''[[a'dam]]'' off. Aviendha fails and then flees back through the gateway with Rand. She is placed into the custody of the [[Seekers for Truth]] by [[Jalindin]].{{ref/book|5|32}}
